notes: Access: free, no login/VIN. The manuals page (Year/Make/Model selector web component gma-cs-mmy-selector) queries GM's public content-search XHR https://contentdelivery.ext.gm.com/bypass/gma-search-api/searchapi/solr/gma-public/select (params fq=locale:en_US, fq=channel:*MANUALS*, fq=file_type:application/pdf, q=+YEAR +MAKE +MODEL); model list from .../solr/make-model-year/select (region GMNA, country US). Every document URL below is the 'path' returned by that API for the US/en_US index and is hosted on GM's asset host contentdelivery.ext.gm.com (/content/dam/cope/en_us/public/pdf_assets/active/...). Verified 2026-10-02 with GET Range bytes=0-1023: all returned HTTP 206, body starts with %PDF, Content-Type application/pdf; size_bytes from Content-Range. US edition: English US index (locale en_US); 2017+ file names carry en_US and the _U_ (US) market marker. GM's English owner manuals are generally single editions for US and Canada (English); French-Canadian editions are not in this index and are not included. Maintenance schedules are a chapter of each owner manual; GM publishes no separate maintenance booklet for these lines. doc_type warranty_maintenance = GM brand-wide 'Limited Warranty and Owner Assistance Information' booklet for that model year (same URL repeats across lines). Deliberately excluded although present in the index: infotainment manuals, Spanish (es_US) 'Manual del Propietario' editions (2023 only), the multi-year 'California Warranty Information for 2018-2025 GM Owner's Manuals' insert, and EV models (Equinox EV, Escalade IQ/IQL). Chevrolet specifics: Malibu Hybrid (2016-2019) has no separate document in GM's index (search 'Malibu Hybrid' returns only the regular Malibu manuals), so the Malibu owner manual for each year is the only official manual listed. 2016 Malibu Limited and 2016 Cruze Limited (carry-over previous generation) have their own owner manuals and quick-reference guides, listed under line malibu / cruze 2016 with 'Limited' in the title. Cruze hatchback has no separate manual (covered by the Cruze owner manual). Equinox 2025-2026: printed 'Essential Operating and Safety Information' / 'Vehicle Reference Information' booklets (VRI is bilingual en_US/fr_CA) included as doc_type other. Trax: GM US model list has no 2023 Trax (model not offered in the US for MY2023).
